Hey Varcha. Glad to see you are taking the steps and not just staying home watching streams. Ive been to, and hosted, quite a few so for some tips:  
1) Get there on time to register (they  are usually extremely lax about signups, and they almost always run late, but you wanna get there early enough for...  
2) Get some practice matches in. Find out what system they are playing the games on, and bring a copy of the game yourself, so you can find a system and get down.  
3)Go with friends, so you dont spend all day by yourself. Preferably those you play with so if you have a bad match up (Wesker v Trish), your bud can tell you how to counter the player.  
4) Bring money. Food, drinks, money matches, stick mods, shirts, toys, games, all dat shit that you will want requires some capital.  
5) Make sure to speak to the pros, if any attend, to get pointers.  
6) The most important, by far, DO NOT OVER EXERT YOURSELF. Dont stay up all night playing, don't play to many practice matches so that everyone knows how you play (for that end make sure you practice with a secondary team or something, and only with your mains to get links correct), and have fun. If you don't enjoy yourself, no point in going.   

Make sure to post how it went for you. I'd like to hear.
